summary: SpecNav Operations 0.3.0 rebuilds Verification authority with the installed pre-successor-generation kernel and validates reports against the historical full evidence index, so it rejects the approved successor generation even though project-local Verification finalize and validate are green.
root_causes: Operations resolves kernel and trusted-fact authority from the installed Verification plugin before resolving the target project, so it cannot consume the approved project-local successor-generation override.

Operations requires the complete historical evidence index to equal the current aggregation request, while the approved successor generation intentionally aggregates only generation-scoped evidence and preserves historical repair lineage through signed authority.
The required explicit migration-status artifact is absent even though migration is not required.
authorized_scope_after_approval: Create a narrowly scoped external-worktree authorization for /Volumes/ThesisForgeCI/workspaces/thesis-forge-docforge-verify.
Create and test a project-local SpecNav Operations 0.3.0 override under .specnav/overrides; do not modify the global plugin cache.
Allow only identity-validated explicit Core and project-local Verification roots.
Rebuild and validate successor-generation failure, evidence, reading, report, and authority lineage without weakening gates.
Create deterministic migration-status, final verification receipt, readiness, release-plan, branch-finish, and update-spec artifacts.
Run focused override tests, Verification validate, Operations gate, and archive dry-run; create local semantic commits only.
invariants: No deletion, replacement, or hiding of historical failures, attempts, repairs, reviews, or evidence.
No schema, acceptance, signature, path-security, or fallback weakening.
No non-dry-run archive without a separate explicit approval.

approval.comment: Approved project-local Operations override, closure evidence, validation, archive dry-run, and local commits. Real archive and push remain unauthorized.
